what-is-codex: A person at a desk hands a neat task card to a friendly abstract AI agent (a glowing rounded robot-like assistant, not humanoid), the agent then works across an open laptop with a code editor, a stack of documents and a small terminal window, small checkmarks appearing as steps complete. Conveys delegating a real task to a capable assistant.
agent-basics: Split composition. Left half: a simple chat bubble exchange, one question bubble and one answer bubble, static and flat. Right half: the same assistant now actively working in a loop: reading a folder of files, using a wrench tool, looking at results through a magnifier, adjusting, arranged as a circular loop of four small stations with arrows. Conveys the difference between answering and acting.
context-layers: Three translucent stacked layers floating above each other, feeding light down into a small assistant at the bottom: the top layer holds a rulebook and gear (project rules), the middle layer holds a few highlighted files and folders (selected files), the bottom layer holds a short thread of conversation bubbles. Some irrelevant clutter (crumpled papers) is filtered out to the side by a soft funnel. Conveys giving the right context and filtering noise.
sandbox-and-approval: A small assistant works inside a transparent glass workshop box on a desk, with its tools and files inside the box. At the edge of the box there is a gate with a small approval button, and a human hand outside is about to press approve on a request card held up by the assistant. Network cables outside the box are neatly unplugged with a lock icon shape. Conveys sandbox boundaries and human approval.
local-vs-cloud: Split scene connected by a gentle dotted path. Left: a cozy local workstation, a laptop on a desk with a small assistant working right next to the user. Right: a calm cloud platform floating above, with several identical isolated container boxes each holding a small assistant working in parallel, results flowing back down to the laptop as small parcels. Conveys local versus cloud execution.
verification: A large magnifying glass hovering over a document showing a code diff with green and red highlighted lines, next to it a checklist clipboard with some items checked and one item flagged, and a small test tube rack with green lights. A person calmly reviews. Conveys verifying results before accepting them.
task-brief: A clean blueprint style task card being assembled from four distinct pieces snapping together like puzzle tiles: a target (goal), a folder (context), a fence segment (constraints), and a checkmark badge (definition of done). An assistant receives the completed card with confidence. Conveys writing a clear, complete task.
skills-toolkit: A successful workflow being packaged into a reusable toolbox: a glowing sequence of steps on the left flows into a neat modular toolbox with labeled-looking blank compartments (no text), and copies of the toolbox are being handed to several small assistants on the right. Conveys turning one success into a reusable skill.
cases-deliverables: A bright workshop table showing finished tangible deliverables laid out side by side: a printed weekly report with a small bar chart, a typeset article page, a slide deck fanned out, a laptop showing a simple web page, and a code file with a green checkmark. Each item has a small blank tag. Conveys hands-on practice that ends with real results.
handoff-and-resume: Relay handoff scene: one small assistant passes a neatly organized notebook and a progress bar card to a second assistant across a desk, with a calendar page turning in the background and a bookmark placed in a half-finished task board. Conveys handing off work and resuming later without losing progress.
learning-paths: An illustrated map with four distinct winding paths starting from the same open book at the bottom: one path for a beginner with a small flag, one for a creator with a pen and paper, one for a developer with a laptop and brackets shape, one for a team with several small figures together. Paths lead upward to a summit with a checkmark. Conveys choosing a learning path by role.
team-guardrails: A small team of diverse people around a table collaborating with several small assistants, surrounded by soft protective guardrails and a shield shape, a shared rulebook in the middle, and a review station where a person signs off on work. Conveys team adoption with governance and safety.
home-weekly-report: A messy spreadsheet grid on the left with a few rows highlighted (duplicates struck through, a refund row marked), transforming via a glowing arrow into a clean one-page weekly report on the right with a bar chart, a small line trend and a reconciliation checklist with green checks. Close-up, centered composition, simple and iconic.
home-bug-fix: A code editor panel with a failing test indicator glowing red, a small bug creature being gently lifted out with tweezers, and the same test indicator turning green on a second panel, connected by a small wrench. Close-up, centered composition, simple and iconic.
home-article: Three source documents of different colors on the left (one with a highlighted quote, one with a small table, one with a date stamp) with thin connecting threads leading into a neatly typeset article page on the right that has footnote markers and a small fact table. Close-up, centered composition, simple and iconic.
home-path-beginner: A friendly beginner sitting with a laptop showing a single simple card, a small assistant beside them, a safety helmet shape and three stepping stones in front leading forward, a small green check on the first stone. Simple, iconic, centered.
home-path-creator: A creator at a desk with a stack of source notes, an article page and a fanned set of presentation slides emerging from them, a pen and a small assistant helping arrange the slides. Simple, iconic, centered.
home-path-developer: A developer at a desk with two monitors: one showing code with a highlighted line, the other showing test results with green bars, a small assistant pointing at the diff, a handoff notebook on the desk. Simple, iconic, centered.
home-path-team: A small team of three people around a table with a shared calendar showing a two-week plan, a checklist board and a few small assistants, one person holding a rollback arrow shaped badge. Simple, iconic, centered.
start-here: A trailhead at the edge of a calm landscape with a large signpost of blank arrow boards pointing to several paths, an open guidebook on a stand, a small friendly assistant waving the reader in. Conveys a welcoming starting point.
getting-started: A short sequence of four stepping platforms rising left to right: a laptop being set up, a key card for signing in, a small project folder, and a first task card with a green check at the top platform. A small assistant walks along with a person. Conveys a quick setup path.
undo-and-recover: A file document being restored: a translucent rewind arrow circles around a stack of version snapshots, one older snapshot glows and slides back into place, a safety net below catches a crumpled page. Conveys undo and recovery.
permissions-approvals: A row of four doors or gates with different lock levels: an open door for reading files, a door with a small key for writing, a door with a switch for running commands, a door with a globe shape for network access. A person holds a ring of keys and decides which to hand to a small assistant. Conveys permission levels.
tokens-compaction: A long unrolled scroll of conversation bubbles flowing into a press machine that compacts it into a small neat summary card, which then fits snugly into a limited window frame with room to spare. Conveys context limits and compaction.
threads-tasks-projects: Nested containers: a large project box contains several task folders, each task folder contains a few thread strands of conversation bubbles, arranged clearly like a cutaway diagram, a small assistant organizing them. Conveys how projects, tasks, and threads nest.
desktop-app: A calm desktop control center on a large monitor: several task cards in columns with progress rings, one card expanded showing a side-by-side diff with green and red lines, an approval toggle, a small assistant busy in each lane. Conveys managing parallel local tasks in a desktop app.
cli: A large terminal window with a dark pane and glowing prompt cursor, blocks of abstract command lines (no readable text) and a small assistant sitting on top of the terminal frame typing on a mini keyboard, with pipes connecting to a script scroll and a test tube. Conveys working in the command line.
ide: A code editor with a file tree on the left, a highlighted code selection in the middle, and a side panel where a small assistant suggests an inline change with a small accept button. Conveys an assistant inside the editor.
web-and-cloud: A web browser window showing a repository card connected by a dotted line up to a cloud with isolated container boxes running tasks, finished results returning as a pull request shaped card with a green check. Conveys delegating tasks to the cloud from the web.
tools-overview: A neat tool belt laid out on a table: a terminal window badge, a browser window badge, a magnifier for search, an image frame, a microphone, and a cursor pointer for computer use, with a small assistant choosing the right one. Conveys choosing tools.
files-and-artifacts: A conveyor loop passing by a small assistant: different file types ride on it as distinct shapes, a code file with brackets, an image frame, a PDF booklet, a spreadsheet grid, a slide deck, each getting a small inspection check. Conveys handling many file types and checking outputs.
agent-planning: A small assistant drawing a step-by-step plan on a whiteboard as a vertical sequence of numbered-looking blank boxes connected by arrows, while a person points at one step to adjust it before work begins. Conveys planning before execution.
agents-md: A repository folder tree in cutaway: a thick guidebook sits at the root folder, smaller note cards are pinned in nested subfolders, and a small assistant reads the guidebook first, then the nearest note card. Conveys project instruction files and scope.
prompt-injection: A document and a web page float toward a small assistant; hidden inside the web page a tiny sneaky note with a red tint is caught by a translucent shield filter, while the clean content passes through. Conveys defending against prompt injection.
mcp-overview: A small assistant at the center plugs into a universal adapter hub; standardized cables run from the hub to distinct external services shown as icons: a database cylinder, a calendar, a ticket board, a cloud drive. Conveys connecting external tools through a standard protocol.
plugins-overview: Sealed package boxes with a ribbon, each containing a small toolbox and gear, travel along a track and are installed onto several identical workstations, one package being opened, one being cleanly removed. Conveys packaging and distributing extensions.
prompt-debugging: A person compares two output cards side by side on a workbench: the left output misses a target board, the right hits the center; between them a task card is being adjusted with a small screwdriver and a magnifier. Conveys diagnosing and improving a prompt.
long-running-tasks: A long winding road with checkpoint flags at intervals and a progress bar banner above, a small assistant carrying a backpack walks the road, a person at a checkpoint holds a signpost to steer direction. Conveys long tasks with checkpoints and steering.
failure-recovery: A small block tower that partially toppled is calmly being rebuilt by a person and a small assistant following a checklist, a rollback arrow returning a block to a stable base, a first aid style kit nearby. Conveys recovering from failures methodically.
